title: Treat this human birth as an invitation
summary: The verse does not flatter the body; it gives it a purpose. Spend today as someone invited to meet the Lord while breath is still here.
takeaway: Let one choice today answer the rare chance you were given.
lifeApplication: Choose one embodied act of remembrance, service, or restraint that treats this life as a meeting-place, not background noise.

source.shortMeaning: The human body is given as the soul’s chance to meet Gobind while time remains.
source.lifeApplication: Before maintenance swallows the day, let one action answer the gift of being here.

evidence.coreClaim: The human body is given as the soul’s chance to meet Gobind while time remains.
evidence.turn: The body becomes sacred when it is used as an answer to the invitation to meet, not as an object to maintain or display.
evidence.practicalImplication: Choose one embodied act of remembrance, service, or restraint that treats this life as a meeting-place, not background noise.
